summary.tagline: Far from the hustle and bustle of everyday life, the Sölktäler are the ideal place to rest and regain strength

days.title: Hiking the Kleinsölktal Valley
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Breitlahnalm
stops.detail: The easy but very varied hike leads you from the Breitlahnalm in the Kleinsölk valley to the Schwarzensee lake and further to the rustic huts of the Putzental Almen, where you can enjoy specialities of the nature park (e.g. fresh brook trout, Steirerkäsbrot and much more).

days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Kaltenbachalm
stops.detail: Above the Kaltenbachalm, at the sharp bend in the road, there is a small parking lot.

stops.name: ersten Kaltenbachsee
stops.detail: From there, the trail leads over the stream and then in many serpentines up to the first Kaltenbach lake.

stops.name: Oberen Kaltenbachsee
stops.detail: Above the tree line, the trail leads up over a long slope to the Upper Kaltenbach lake.
